design.offArm: observed per-CPU persistence; no recommendation applied
design.onArm: one normalized 0.10 response step using the repository demand multiplier and -1.9 price elasticity
design.conservedQuantity: sum of per-CPU busy fractions within each interval
design.thermalSwingTreatment: not measured; utilisationEMA equals current utilisation so no swing surcharge is invented
design.priceTreatment: official price drives one common dimensionless E multiplier; it cancels from within-host relative allocation
design.timeAlignment: host telemetry and the historical market trace are independent streams paired by ordinal only, not co-temporal observations
